button.label: Additional material ({format}, {size})
button.noPermission: {label}: downloads are not enabled for your account
button.failed: The download could not be started. Try again in a moment.
config.title: Additional Material
config.intro: Offers a download button on items that have an archive stored beside them:
config.folderArchive: additional-material.zip in a series (course) or season (section) folder
config.videoArchive: <video file name>.material.zip beside an episode (lesson) or movie
config.librariesHelp: The plugin only looks in the libraries ticked here.
config.requireDownloadHelp: Users without it see the button disabled. This is the permission Jellyfin's own Download button uses.
config.linkMinutesHelp: How long a download has to start after the button is pressed.
config.styleMono: One color, like the buttons beside it
config.styleColor: Two colors: the plus in an accent color
config.accentHelp: Used for the plus in the two-color style. Jellyfin's own accent is #00A4DC.
dialog.title: Additional material
dialog.noPermission: Downloads are not enabled for your account.
config.levels: Show material from lower levels on
config.levelsItem: Only the item it belongs to
config.levelsHelp: On a course or section page, the button then lists the archives below it, with links to each lesson.
config.cards: Show the icon on cards in grid views
config.lists: Show the icon on rows in list views
dialog.loadFailed: The contents could not be read. Try again in a moment.
config.nested: List the files inside zips that are inside the material
config.nestedHelp: A zip inside an archive (for example a lab pack) can then be opened in the Contents view and its files downloaded one by one.
config.indexHelp: The plugin remembers which folders hold material, re-reading them after every library scan. Re-read now after adding or changing zips.
config.tagline: Download buttons and a contents view for course material stored beside your videos.
config.aboutRepository: Plugin repository, for Dashboard → Plugins → Repositories (name it 4o66):
config.aboutLicense: Free software under the GNU GPL, version 3.
config.build: Build archives from the files stored with the videos
config.buildHelp: Uses the helper script's rules: lesson files go with their lesson, section and course files with their section and course, and programs, scripts and documents with macros or embedded code are replaced by a note. Courses that already have archives (made by hand or by the script) are left as they are.
config.buildBackground: Build in the background after library scans
config.buildBackgroundHelp: Otherwise an archive is built the first time someone downloads it. Archives are rebuilt when their files change.
config.locationBeside: Beside the videos (the plugin's cache where that folder cannot be written)
config.locationCache: Always in the plugin's cache: never write to the media folders
config.singleFiles: Hand out a single file as it is, without an archive
config.singleFilesHelp: A lesson whose only material is one PDF downloads as that PDF.
config.singleZipFrom: Zip a single file anyway from this size (MB)
config.singleZipFromHelp: Only when zipping makes it noticeably smaller: the plugin checks a sample of the file, and never zips formats that are compressed already (images, Office files, video, zip).
config.leftOut: Files left out by a rule
config.leftOutHelp: Adverts, shortcuts and links pointing outside the library are left out of built archives. The contents view can list them, with the reason:
config.builtHelp: Rebuilds every archive the plugin builds, from the files on the disk now. Archives made by hand or by the script are never touched.
config.building.result: {planned} archives planned, {current} built and up to date. {alone} courses have their own archives and are left as they are.
config.building.failed: {failed} could not be built; see the server log.
